payload.raw: Mermaid rendering is provided via a code fence renderer mapped to `mermaid` code fences.

inline.text: Mermaid rendering is provided via a code fence renderer mapped to
mermaid
code fences.

payload.highlightedHtml:
import { StreamingMarkdown } from "stream-mdx";
import { MermaidBlock } from "@stream-mdx/mermaid";

<StreamingMarkdown
  text={content}
  worker="/workers/markdown-worker.js"
  codeRenderers={{
    mermaid: MermaidBlock,
  }}
  features={{
    html: true,
    tables: true,
    math: true,
    mdx: true,
  }}
/>;

payload.raw: Custom configuration and error handling

inline.text: Custom configuration and error handling

payload.raw: Use `createMermaidBlock` to configure global Mermaid options, default views, debounce intervals, a custom/pinned Mermaid module or async loader, or a custom error component with retry capability:

inline.text: Use
createMermaidBlock
to configure global Mermaid options, default views, debounce intervals, a custom/pinned Mermaid module or async loader, or a custom error component with retry capability:

payload.highlightedHtml:
import { createMermaidBlock } from "@stream-mdx/mermaid";
import { StreamingMarkdown } from "stream-mdx";

const CustomMermaidBlock = createMermaidBlock({
  config: { theme: "neutral" },
  defaultView: "diagram",
  debounceMs: 150,
  mermaid: () => import("mermaid"), // optional custom instance or custom loader
  errorComponent: ({ error, retry }) => (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm">
      <p className="font-medium text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">Diagram rendering failed: {error}</p>
      <button type="button" onClick={retry} className="mt-2 text-xs underline">
        Retry diagram
      </button>
    </div>
  ),
});

<StreamingMarkdown
  text={content}
  codeRenderers={{
    mermaid: CustomMermaidBlock,
  }}
/>;

payload.raw: Troubleshooting

inline.text: Troubleshooting

payload.raw:
- **No diagram appears**: verify `@stream-mdx/mermaid` is installed and registered in `codeRenderers={{ mermaid: MermaidBlock }}`.
- **Hydration mismatch**: ensure wrappers/components around Mermaid are deterministic.
- **Layout overflow**: add responsive container styles around the diagram block.
